resources.string: The hermes-android plugin is installed on this server (profile %1$s) but not enabled for %2$s. Hermes profiles are isolated, so each one turns it on separately. One tap enables it here with the same install and server key, and pairs this phone.
Once enabled, this profile uses the same server key as %1$s (project %2$s). There is nothing to upload.
Once the plugin is enabled for this profile, upload the server key here.
